public.text: The phrase “an interoperability capability that standardises data exchange” is vague and may still be interpreted as procuring a mediator or integration platform.
public.suggestedRevision: Specify that the capability includes governed standards, profiles, terminology, endpoint registration, trust, interfaces, mappings, testing, monitoring, and mediation mechanisms selected for the context.
